title: Eight cyclic fields with fused five-bit cells and expanded exact proper-run certificates

claims.statement: The explicit 8-field degree-125 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-125 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 6874551108971997388164788375717/100000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=153258719451355685441677901400291967525453399414062387 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(2229325/12618).

experiments.purpose: Check field, fused cells, 359-operation cube and exact work (0), ten pair cutoffs and proper-run lengths 1–4 (1), 231 exact child weights (2), and proper-run lengths 5–7 and exact error (3).
